`ShortcutService` has exactly five RPCs, all implemented in one backend file:

**RPCs** (defined in `proto/api/v1/shortcut_service.proto`, lines 14–52):
1. `ListShortcuts(ListShortcutsRequest) → ListShortcutsResponse` — `GET /api/v1/{parent=users/*}/shortcuts`
2. `GetShortcut(GetShortcutRequest) → Shortcut` — `GET /api/v1/{name=users/*/shortcuts/*}`
3. `CreateShortcut(CreateShortcutRequest) → Shortcut` — `POST /api/v1/{parent=users/*}/shortcuts`
4. `UpdateShortcut(UpdateShortcutRequest) → Shortcut` — `PATCH /api/v1/{shortcut.name=users/*/shortcuts/*}`
5. `DeleteShortcut(DeleteShortcutRequest) → google.protobuf.Empty` — `DELETE /api/v1/{name=users/*/shortcuts/*}`

**Implementing file:** `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go`, where all five are methods on `*APIV1Service` (`ListShortcuts` at line 49, `GetShortcut` at 95, `CreateShortcut` at 135, `UpdateShortcut` at 211, `DeleteShortcut` at 284).

One thing worth noting is that the Connect-protocol handlers in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` (lines 526–566) are thin wrappers only — each one unwraps the `connect.Request` and delegates straight to the corresponding `APIV1Service` method, so the real logic lives entirely in `shortcut_service.go`. The generated stubs in `proto/gen/api/v1/` (`shortcut_service_grpc.pb.go`, `apiv1connect/shortcut_service.connect.go`, `shortcut_service.pb.gw.go`) are codegen, not implementations.
